critical_code_review_comments: routes/margin_shield.py at ~540 lines is fine for a single-module scope but borderline — if a 6th feature is added, consider splitting scoring/compliance helpers into a separate sub-module.

_score_carrier_for_load uses random.Random seeded by load_id for DAT/Truckstop synthetic rates which is deterministic — good. But _historical_rate falls back to a hardcoded $1100 when bookings list is empty AND no rate_usd entries exist; consider documenting this fallback in the API response so UI can flag the rate as 'lane-default' rather than 'historical avg'.

auto-invoice mutates booking + inserts 3 docs sequentially (brokerage_invoices, qbo_ar_queue, invoice_email_drafts) without a transaction — if any insert mid-way fails, you can end up with a partial state (invoice issued, no QBO entry). Either use a Motor transaction or document the at-least-once semantics. Idempotency via the already_invoiced check on retry partially compensates.

Compliance _compliance_check default csa_safety_score=50 means a carrier with NO csa data on file silently passes the safety check (50<65). Consider warn-by-default for missing data so admins notice un-vetted carriers.
Frontend MarginShield.jsx imports lucide-react icon `Users` and `XCircle` but `Users` is unused — minor dead-code cleanup.

Auto-Invoice tab body uses an internal AutoInvoiceForm component but no list of recent invoices — could add a small recent-invoices feed (last 5) under the form so admins see the side-effects of recent auto-invoices without leaving the page.

Loyalty list 'createProgram' resets the form state to a fixed default object after successful create — if user toggles to bonus_type='flat' and creates, the next form resets back to 'percent' silently. Tiny UX nit.
